tools.description: Free health check. Reports whether the upstream scrub service is reachable. No payment required, no arguments, no text processed.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrub_text · Public sink: scrub_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrub_text · Public sink: scrub_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
